critical_code_review_comments: ChatPage.jsx is 727 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting Header, MessagesList, and InputBar into subcomponents in a future refactor.

Line 550 uses hard-coded pixel margins (80px header / 76px input). If header padding changes with safe-area on notched devices, messages may be partly clipped behind header. Consider using CSS variables or measuring header/input height dynamically.

Line 627 formats timestamp from msg.created_at, but line 321 sets the optimistic temp message field as `timestamp`. Optimistic messages will render 'Invalid Date' briefly until replaced by server response.

Line 462: entire user-info block is a <button>, but line 466 wraps another interactive area. The avatar image inside the button re-navigates to profile; acceptable, but nested interactive semantics could confuse a11y readers.
Line 16: `import.meta.env` fallback in CRA (webpack) code path is dead code — CRA doesn't support import.meta.env; safe but misleading.
showAvatar shows an empty 7x7 spacer div (line 599) for continuation messages — good, preserves alignment. Verified.
